summary: Verified fix for partner-app bug: 30-min scheduled-work reminder full-screen alert now shows while the app is OPEN (previously only the ring sound played). Code-reviewed both frontend fixes and ran backend contract test for GET /api/bookings/partner/reminder-pending. 2/2 pytest cases pass. tsc --noEmit on /app/frontend returns exit 0 (only a non-blocking baseUrl deprecation notice). No android/ folder present.

JobRingOverlay.tsx.enqueue_uses_rem_key_for_reminder: L146: handledKey = job._reminder ? `rem:${job.id}` : job.id — so an accepted booking's id in handledRef no longer blocks the scheduled_reminder for the SAME booking.
JobRingOverlay.tsx.dismiss_reminder_adds_rem_key: L288: handledRef.current.add(`rem:${job.id}`) — dismissed reminder won't re-pop in this session.
JobRingOverlay.tsx.30min_cooldown_still_enforced: L150: wasReminderShownRecently(job.id) blocks re-show across reopens; L172-174 calls markReminderShown when overlay mounts.
JobRingOverlay.tsx.sse_and_poll_paths_covered: SSE 'scheduled_reminder' handler L182 and 6s poll of /bookings/partner/reminder-pending L194/205 both call enqueue with _reminder:true.

backgroundRing.ts.foreground_early_return_for_ring_types: L56-59: if (RING_TYPES.has(type)) { if (AppState.currentState === 'active') return; ... } — background SSE listener no longer plays the tone / posts Notifee while app is foreground. Overlay owns foreground UX.
backgroundRing.ts.background_locked_unchanged: Still calls displayJobRing + startRingSound + _forceOpenApp when AppState !== 'active'.

regression_check.job_request_dedup_unchanged: handledKey falls back to job.id for non-reminder jobs — accepted/rejected jobs still deduped.
regression_check.reschedule_bypasses_dedup: L147 has `&& !job._resched` guard — reschedule ring still bypasses handledRef on an accepted booking.

rca of the issue: Root cause: In JobRingOverlay.tsx, enqueue() dedup used booking.id as the key. Accepting a job added that id to handledRef; the subsequent 'scheduled_reminder' SSE/poll event for the SAME booking was then silently dropped while the app stayed open — so no modal mounted and the overlay's own ring never started. Meanwhile backgroundRing.ts (always-on SSE listener for background push-independent ring) still fired startRingSound() on the ring_types event in foreground, giving the 'sound only' symptom. On reopen, handledRef resets (in-memory Set), so the reminder could finally be enqueued. Fix: (1) scope the handledRef key for reminders to `rem:${id}` so accepted-booking reminders aren't blocked; (2) in backgroundRing._handle, early-return when AppState==='active' so the overlay owns foreground UX. The 30-min cooldown via wasReminderShownRecently/markReminderShown prevents the fix from re-popping the reminder on every app reopen within the window.
